title: Level Crossing in Random Matrices. III. Analogs of Girko's circular and Wigner's semicircle laws
summary: We study the asymptotic distribution of level crossings for random matrix pencils A_n+λB_n in several ensembles, including complex and real i.i.d. matrices and Gaussian/Hermitian settings. We derive a representation of the normalized log-discriminant in terms of pairwise eigenvalue interactions and formulate conditions under which its limit is governed by a deterministic potential.
